reason: distinguish STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE from UNOBSERVED source absence

amends.original_wording: an absent minute means ZERO volume, not missing volume
amends.defect: true only when the minute was a real trading minute, the security was eligible, and source coverage is proven complete. Applied unconditionally it converts vendor outages, pagination gaps and coverage holes into measured zeros.
amends.charter_not_rewritten: the charter remains sealed at its own digest with its original text; this artifact narrows the clause

OBSERVED.definition: a vendor bar exists for the minute

STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE.definition: an expected trading minute in which the security was eligible, the covering source interval is proven complete, and no bar was legitimately emitted because nothing traded
preconditions_ALL_REQUIRED: the minute lies inside a session per the SEALED exchange calendar, accounting for holidays and early closes
the security was index-eligible on that date per the PIT universe contract
the source interval covering the minute PASSED the pagination completeness gate (strict monotonicity, zero duplicates, zero page-boundary gaps, deterministic replay)
no trading halt covering the minute is recorded
STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE.forward_fill: NEVER — the absence of a trade is not the persistence of a price
STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE.note: this is a real observation whose value is zero

triggers: exchange calendar unresolved for the date
UNOBSERVED.explicitly_not_zero: an UNOBSERVED minute is NEVER coerced to zero volume, in storage, in aggregation, or in any feature
UNOBSERVED.note: this is the absence of an observation, not an observation

default_state.rule: UNOBSERVED is the DEFAULT for any absent minute
default_state.promotion: a minute is promoted to STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE only when every precondition is affirmatively demonstrated
default_state.why: the burden of proof runs toward the conservative state. A pipeline that defaults to zero and downgrades on discovered problems will silently record zeros for every problem it never discovered.

propagation.rule: a coarser bar (15m/1H/1D) whose window contains ANY UNOBSERVED minute is flagged UNOBSERVED_CONTAMINATED and carries the count of such minutes
propagation.why: summing volume over a window with unobserved minutes understates it, and the understatement is invisible in the result
propagation.usage: a contaminated bar is not silently dropped and not silently used; each study declares its own tolerance, and the declaration is part of that study's specification
propagation.vwap: a window whose observed volume is 0 has NULL vwap regardless of whether the zero is structural or contaminated

rvol_consequence.slot_rvol: the per-slot baseline is computed over OBSERVED and STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE minutes only; UNOBSERVED minutes are excluded from both numerator and denominator
rvol_consequence.cum_rvol: a cumulative curve crossing an UNOBSERVED minute is flagged from that point forward for that session
rvol_consequence.reported: every RVOL-family feature reports the count of excluded UNOBSERVED minutes alongside its value

assert_contract_additions: every stored minute carries an explicit availability state from the three above; a null or missing state is a fatal ingestion error
no row may carry availability=STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE together with a non-null price or a non-zero volume
no row may carry availability=UNOBSERVED together with any numeric volume, including zero
a STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE row must reference the completeness-gate result that licensed its promotion
authorises: nothing — this narrows a definition and starts no download
